newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SPANISH CUP SETBACK FOR DEPORTIVO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPANISH CUP SETBACK FOR DEPORTIVO.

text.p: Deportivo Coruna, winners of the Spanish Cup in 1995, suffered a 1-0 reverse in the first leg of their second round tie of this season's domestic cup at Mallorca on Wednesday.
They were among three first division sides beaten in the first leg of the two-leg ties.
Most of the 14 first division clubs which faced teams from lower divisions were left comfortably placed ahead of the second leg.
Real Madrid had to work hard at recently relegated Salamanca but came away with a 2-0 win thanks to a late penalty from Fernando Hierro.
Clubs involved in European competition, such as Barcelona and Cup holders Atletico Madrid, were exempt from the second round.
